spec_references: ## Statements: "[While](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#while-stmt)", "[If/else](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_7.18)", "[Local variable declarations](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#local-var-decl-stmt)" and "[Return](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#return-stmt)" are listed; do statements and standalone block statements are not listed.
reason: The whole case is feature-scoped because test21 essentially tests narrowing across a do statement, which is absent from the supported statements list. The same function also tests a standalone block, likewise not listed. The remaining while/type-test negative checks largely exercise listed statements and expressions, and illegal assignments alone do not make them out of scope.

test_design_notes: Mixed scope: supported while-condition narrowing checks share a file with uncovered do/block scope checks.
